principle: DONE is prohibited as a single undifferentiated production claim.

axes.question: Is the intended implementation complete against the work package?
Are required identities, mappings, baselines, facts, freshness and quality established?
Can this exact revision be safely deployed through every required release plane?
Is the exact deployed production revision healthy and usable?
Does the real user/device/site workflow work under operational conditions?

promotion_rule: A higher axis may be evaluated while a lower axis is incomplete, but overall production acceptance MUST NOT be stated above the lowest required failing/blocking axis.
cross_project_gate: Before a Builder OS standard is promoted from PROJECT_VERIFIED to CROSS_PROJECT_VERIFIED, it must have independent evidence from at least one additional project/domain or an external authoritative standard plus a reproduced local eval.
